about: What each YouTube Data API method costs against the daily quota. Hand-maintained: Google publishes the numbers as a web page, not as data. tools/generate.php turns this into src/YouTube/Quota/Cost.php and quotes each cost in the method's documentation, and refuses to run if a method in spec/discovery.json is missing here.
sources: The 'Quota impact' line of each method's reference page

default.about: Every method not listed in another bucket, in units.

search.about: search.list has its own bucket of calls, each costing 1.

uploads.about: videos.insert has its own bucket of calls, each costing 1.

estimated.abuseReports.insert: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.comments.markAsSpam: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.liveChatMessages.stream: Google does not publish it, so each connection is counted as one list call
estimated.members.list: the quota calculator says 1 and the method's own page says 2
estimated.tests.insert: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.thirdPartyLinks.delete: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.thirdPartyLinks.insert: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.thirdPartyLinks.list: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a read
estimated.thirdPartyLinks.update: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a write
estimated.videoTrainability.get: Google does not publish it, so it is counted as a read
